data.body: [P1] Job-level concurrency is still lossy: GitHub retains only one pending job for this group. If a newer version is pending behind another update and a lower backport reaches the group, the backport cancels the newer job; because the survivor only publishes when its own `VERSION` is newest, it exits and can leave `latest` on an older image indefinitely. Make every surviving serialized job derive and publish the maximum registry version, or use a queue/lock that preserves every waiter.
